updates.title: Parameters are editable from each strategy page, with version history and one-click revert
updates.impact: New paramstore.py is the single door for parameter writes: ~47 whitelisted fields with range guards, validated through the real Config loader before anything is written, every version storing the full pre-change config so revert is exact. Identity fields (ledger, log, strategy, mode, wallet) stay unwritable. Reverting is recorded as a version too. It immediately caught qvwap/qdip/qsurge running a 10x take-profit rung under a 3x hard cap - the rung can never fire, so those books have no trailing stop.

updates.title: The three quest strategies (qvwap / qdip / qsurge) restarted as paper traders and added to the Monte Carlo
updates.impact: They had died at 07:44 with no supervision. New qfam_pool.py freezes their pools to reports/qfam_backtest.json and asserts them equal to validate.run() trade-for-trade, so the page cannot show an unscored number. Mean 2.384x / 2.410x / 2.174x, and 99.3-99.9% of no_top paths profitable - the tail test that took base, bounce and H1 to zero.

updates.title: Monte Carlo now covers every live book: grinder and bounce added, holder declared missing by name
updates.impact: bookpools.py regenerates BOUNCE (n=340, 1.208x) and HOLDER through the same corrected engine as every other pool, instead of freshlab's censoring-off numbers. HOLDER yields only 4 trades - its gate features cover 351 tokens, of which 28 pass H1 - so it is listed in the caveats rather than bootstrapped, because resampling 4 trades is theatre. 12 pools on the dropdown.

updates.title: ACTIVE UNITS shows every open paper position, from every book
updates.impact: The panel read the launch config's ledger only, so a position held by any of the other ten books was invisible while it was live. Each unit card now carries the strategy that opened it and draws its ladder from THAT book's exits - the ticks were previously drawn from the wrong config (base runs a 20x hard-TP, the quest families 50x).

updates.title: Paper trial STARTED - 1.0 SOL account, backtest parameters (asym-runner v2 exits + base-entry gate, 0.25 SOL units, max 3)
updates.impact: Baseline. The locked arbiter is live; all numbers below serve this trial.

updates.title: Birdeye Premium purchased (20M CU/mo, 50 RPS, websocket) - usage meter recalibrated to the new cycle
updates.impact: 8x data budget, overage $15->$9.9/1M CU, websocket entitlement unlocked.

updates.title: Websocket wired into the bot: listing discovery at birth + live 1m candles + backtest entry_setup_ok() gate running live
updates.impact: Closes the two biggest backtest->live gaps (candle pattern gate + $8k cumulative volume floor). Edge fidelity, not edge change.

updates.title: WS multi-token price subscription format fixed (boolean-expression string; JSON arrays are silently ignored)
updates.impact: Live candles actually stream (46 ticks/15s verified); from-birth coverage without REST backfills.

updates.title: Qualification stats switched GeckoTerminal -> Birdeye REST (market-data + trade-data/single; GT demoted to fallback + backstop discovery)
updates.impact: ~30x rate headroom on the qualification call; ends 429-storm candidate loss (est +10-30% candidates evaluated/day); ~45 CU/token.

updates.title: Listing re-broadcast dedup fix (watchlist entries keep listed_ts + promoted flag)
updates.impact: No duplicate promotions/deep-check spend (BECOON was evaluated twice).

updates.title: Throughput levers pulled: WS promotions 3->10 per cycle, watchlist listing floor $2,000->$500
updates.impact: Candidate flow scales toward the full listing stream (est 3-5x more WS candidates/day). Zero strategy gates touched.

updates.title: Restart continuity: WS watchlist/candles/counters persist to reports/ws_state.json (60s snapshots + on shutdown); setup gate re-backfills stale candle tails; dashboard relaunched with --config config.asym.json
updates.impact: Bot restarts resume with a warm funnel - listing ages, promoted flags and candle coverage survive. Rejection table reads the right log again after tonight's manual restart dropped the flag.

updates.title: Smart-money + insider gates switched to SHADOW mode (log verdict, take the trade anyway); rugcheck stays a hard block
updates.impact: Day-1 audit: these never-backtested gates killed 100% of setup-passing candidates (bundle-sniper tag hit 9-10/10 top traders on every young token). Trial now tests the strategy that was actually backtested; shadow verdicts accumulate evidence on whether the gates add value.

updates.title: SORTIE LOG view tabs: LIVE PAPER <-> BACKTEST switcher in the panel header (choice sticks via localStorage)
updates.impact: Backtest journal stays one click away now that live closes exist (it previously vanished once the first paper trade closed). Display only - no data or strategy change.

updates.title: Repo pushed to GitHub + public Pages dashboard live at krazysnipeoof.github.io/AI-memes-strat (pages_publish.py loop, 5-min snapshots to gh-pages)
updates.impact: Dashboard readable from anywhere without the local server. Static JSON snapshots of /api/state + /api/bdusage; wallet field nulled; staleness badge shows data age. Ledger/logs/caches/.env stay gitignored.

updates.title: Wallet harvester + tracked-wallet shadow annotations: top-trader wallets from every deep check persist to wallets.sqlite; 18 seed wallets (kolscan/Nansen, unverified) watched via reports/tracked_wallets.json; WALLET INTEL dashboard panel
updates.impact: Zero extra API spend (reuses the smart-money gate's top_traders call) and zero gate changes - tracked hits only annotate ENTER lines. Builds the niche-native insider list that public leaderboards can't provide.

updates.title: walletscout.py + WALLETS tab: on-chain scout ranks wallets by REALIZED >=10x round trips (leaderboard 'pnl' proven to be unrealized-mark mirages); top 5 scouted wallets merged into the tracked watchlist; /wallets tab added to every page nav + GitHub Pages
updates.impact: First data-verified copy-trade candidates (best: 25 round trips/14d, 80% wins, 14 trips >=10x). wallet_scout.json stores per-token entry timestamps so a copy-trade backtest can replay entries against cached OHLCV. Observational only - trial gates untouched.

updates.title: Copy-trade backtest (copytrade_backtest.py) + live progress bar on the WALLETS tab: follower simulated at 0/5/15/30/60m lag under MIRROR vs STRATEGY exit over 499 round trips
updates.impact: MIRROR-copying is a trap (+5m lag avg 0.43x - you're exit liquidity); STRATEGY exit fares far better BUT the token set is the wallets' winners only (optimistic selection). Fast snipers uncopyable, slow long-hold wallets copyable; co-accumulation (76 clusters) runs 24.9x vs 17.6x solo; 7xKrgU61 leads 26 clusters = front-run trigger. Progress bar polls /api/copytrade; RE-RUN button spawns the backtest (OHLCV cached).

updates.title: Unbiased cluster-confirmation backtest (cluster_backtest.py): every buy from the wallets' raw swap stream (752 tokens, winners AND rugs), not the scout's winners-only set
updates.impact: VERDICT: co-accumulation does NOT beat naive copying. +5m lag SOLO 83% WR/2.20x ~= ALLBUYS 81%/2.17x > CLUSTER_T2 65%/2.12x. The cluster signal helps the leader, not a lagged follower (stops cap the extra upside). Hypothesis killed cheaply; still wallet-selection biased so not a live edge either.

updates.title: Monte Carlo now runs all 3 strategies (Base-entry / Copy-all / Cluster-confirmed) with a Strategy dropdown; every chart+tile+table re-renders on switch, per-strategy provenance banner discloses each pool's bias
updates.impact: Side-by-side equity-path risk. All 3 show ~0% P(loss) under their own distributions - but copy/cluster are wallet-selection biased + share backtest fill optimism, so the dropdown is a distribution viewer, not a green light. Paper trading stays the arbiter.

updates.title: TRADE JOURNAL strategy filter: STRATEGY row (Base-entry / Copy-all / Cluster-confirmed) combines with the RESULT row (ALL/WINS/LOSSES); each strategy renders full journal cards (chart, levels, at-entry tiles)
updates.impact: Browse any strategy's trades with the same card detail. copy/cluster cards are built by replaying each monitored-wallet buy (+5m) through the exit doctrine over cached OHLCV (cluster_backtest.py card_trades). A per-strategy stats line discloses the wallet-selection bias on copy/cluster.

updates.title: manipscan.py: classifies copy/cluster tokens RUG / WASH_RAMP / SPIKE_DUMP / ORGANIC; TRADE JOURNAL gets a QUALITY filter (HUMAN-LOOKING / SCAM-LIKE) + per-card scam/organic badge; copy/cluster cards now ranked human-first
updates.impact: Quantifies the scam read: 72% of copy/cluster tokens are scam-like (70% instant rugs), only 28% (178) organic/human. Sharpest finding: 0 of 84 co-accumulated CLUSTER tokens are organic - every token 2+ smart wallets piled into is a bot artefact; the human coins are all SOLO-bought. Another nail in cluster-confirmation.

updates.title: ORGANIC-only copy backtest: cluster_backtest.py adds COPY_ORGANIC_HIND (full-history class, look-ahead) + COPY_ORGANIC_LIVE (class judged at trigger, honest)
updates.impact: Filtering copy to human-looking tokens does NOT help. HIND (+5m): 91% WR but 2.05x avg / +105% exp - LOWER than ALLBUYS 81% WR / 2.15x / +115%; the stop doctrine already banks profit before rugs, so 'RUG-by-endstate' tokens are often WINS and filtering them trims winners too. LIVE: only 30/654 tokens are even classifiable at entry, +27.6% exp - the organic signal isn't decidable when you'd trade. Not a rescue.

updates.title: LIVE human-token entry gate on the paper trial: rejects candidates that don't classify ORGANIC on their pre-entry WS candles (excludes rugs/wash-ramps/spike-dumps already damaged by entry). Pure classifier extracted to bot/manip.py
updates.impact: config.asym.json human_filter {enabled:true, shadow:false}. Runs after the setup gate (candles guaranteed), local/zero-API, ~58% of classifiable tokens pass ORGANIC so it won't starve the funnel. HARD gate now - contaminates the (nascent, 4-trade) ledger; set shadow:true to measure-only, enabled:false to revert byte-identical. NOTE: backtest said organic-filtering doesn't improve expectancy, but that was for 5m-old snipes; base bot enters at 30m+ so it's more decidable here - shadow data will tell.

updates.title: Dashboard SORTIE LOG + PAPER TRIAL now show all 3 live strategies (BASE/BOUNCE/HOLDER), not just base
updates.impact: server.py reads each strategy's own paper db (memebot-asym/bounce/holder.sqlite) read-only via STRATEGIES registry + _paper_for(): state gains strategies[] (per-strategy balance/WR/orders/doctrine) + live_sorties[] (merged closes tagged by strategy). index.html renders one PAPER TRIAL panel per strategy and merges tagged closes into SORTIE LOG. Live now: BASE 0.52 SOL/8, BOUNCE 1.05/1, HOLDER 0.87/2. Read-only - does not touch the worktree bounce/holder bots.

updates.title: SORTIE RECORD gets a BY STRATEGY tile row (BASE/BOUNCE/HOLDER balance + WR + PnL + sorties) under the base headline tiles
updates.impact: The top summary is no longer base-only. Base sortie breakdown pulled: 8 trades 1W/7L -0.48 SOL - EVERY trade peaked green (1.07-1.50x) but only 1 closed green; the 1.35x TP banks just 30% and the 30% trailing stop is too wide, so winners round-trip to losses. NOT the human filter (2 post-filter trades passed ORGANIC and still hit stops) - it's the exit doctrine.

updates.title: HOME-RUN strategy created + backtested (homerun_backtest.py -> config.homerun.json): ride-to-30x exit + low-mcap moonshot screen, targeting >=10x at 1-3 trades/week
updates.impact: Rides winners instead of banking early (fixes the base bleed). Backtest on 6039 tokens: at mcap<=$25k+mom+organic (~1-3/wk live) => 58% WR, 1.81x avg, +81% expectancy/trade, captured 3/3 available 10x runners; ride-to-30x beats bank-at-10x at every tier. CAVEATS: high variance (expectancy from 3-4 home runs in ~127 trades), shares backtest fill optimism, and '1-3/wk' is a density-adjusted estimate. NOT deployed - moonshot screen is config metadata, needs a bot gate wired like human_filter. Paper trading is the arbiter.

updates.title: HOME-RUN strategy DEPLOYED as 4th paper bot: moonshot gate wired into try_enter (mcap<=$25k + mom>=1.3x + organic), fresh_candles backfill for setup-off strategies; now in trade journal, Monte Carlo, and per-strategy dashboard panels
updates.impact: run.py --config config.homerun.json live (memebot-homerun.sqlite, ride-to-30x exits). Gate verified rejecting non-moonshots (Cupsey2028 $848k mcap, Tiana $200k). New bot/manip.py-based moonshot gate is config-driven (homerun_screen.enabled), byte-identical off. MC dropdown gets a 4th 'Home-run' strategy (pool 127, +80.7% EV, Sharpe 0.21, p95 DD 14% - high variance). Trade journal gets 80 home-run cards + HOME-RUN filter. Dashboard STRATEGIES registry + reject buckets updated. All 4 bots paper-trading.

updates.title: 3 NEW strategies created, backtested + DEPLOYED live: SNIPER (ultra-early), VOL-ANOMALY (volume spike), DIP-BUY (mean-reversion) - all ORGANIC-only, <=few-hours hold. Now 7 paper bots.
updates.impact: Shared bot/screens.py entry logic (backtest==live). Backtest (newstrat_backtest.py, scan-for-signal mode): Sniper n=2912 72.5% WR +24.7%/trade; Vol-anomaly n=107 61.7% +21.9%; Dip n=1007 53.9% +16.8%; all short holds (9-14m median). Gates verified firing live. Wired into dashboard (7 PAPER TRIAL panels + SORTIE RECORD + BY-STRATEGY), Monte Carlo dropdown, and trade journal (80 cards each + filters). DIP already closed its first trade (+0.003 SOL). Positive-expectancy backtest but shares fill optimism - paper trading is the arbiter.

updates.title: RUG FIX after HAPPYCAT (bought by base/dip/holder, LP pulled minutes later -> unsellable -100%): root cause = rugcheck read lpLockedPct but never gated on it (DIP entry logged 'LP locked 0%' and passed on score alone)
updates.impact: TWO guardrails: (1) ENTRY - rugcheck now rejects LP locked < min_lp_locked_pct (default 50%, would have blocked HAPPYCAT); (2) POST-ENTRY - positions unsellable after void_after_quote_failures (default 8) are auto-VOIDED (status='void': kept in ledger+logs, excluded from PnL/win-rate/balance/open). HAPPYCAT voided across all 3 bots (shown in SORTIE LOG as 'VOID · rug_void' at 0 PnL). Dashboard tracks voided count + voided_sol separately so rug losses stay visible without corrupting stats. Verified live: auto-void caught SalaryCat (22 fails) on restart. 5 main-tree bots restarted; worktree bounce/holder NOT (parallel session's - their HAPPYCAT still voided in-db). CAVEAT: voiding excludes real rug losses from PnL - flatters strategy numbers; voided_sol tally keeps them honest.

updates.title: HONEST ENGINE is now the only engine (main-tree backtest.py replaced with v5: fill slippage, rug=0, dark_stop for data-dark holds) + base exit bleed reduced + 4 strategies paused
updates.impact: Discovered my earlier positive backtests were on the OPTIMISTIC engine; under the honest engine ALL strategies are negative-expectancy (confirms the locked round-4 verdict). Base exit fixed: max_hold 480->120 cuts bleed from -15.6% to -5.3%/trade (still negative). Entry research (entry_research.py): NO entry filter creates a real edge (best +organic = -3.9%, 34% paths green). Paused homerun/sniper/volanomaly/dip (all lose honestly). Kept base (fixed) + parallel session's bounce/holder. Honest truth: no exit or entry change makes these profitable with >=50% paths on this sample - the edge isn't there under honest fills. base_exit_sweep.py (optimistic, misleading), entry_research.py (honest). Old engine backed up to scratchpad; git retains it.

updates.title: Funder-graph reputation protocol built (bot/funder.py) + tested decisively - DEAD, like deployer reputation
updates.impact: resolve_funder(deployer -> oldest tx -> SOL sender) works. Decisive test on blocklist serial-redeploy families (same scam, rotated deployers): SPAIN 7 deployers->7 funders (0 sharing), CXMT 7->7, JIMOTHY 8->6, USOH 6->4. Operations rotate the FUNDER wallet per launch too - no stable identity in the lineage. Deployer rotates (1% repeat), funder rotates (~7->7). On-chain reputation avenue EXHAUSTED. No live gate wired (dead signal). bot/funder.py kept for forensics.

updates.title: FUNDER GRAPH dashboard tab (/fundergraph): visualizes the wallet-rotation finding as token->deployer->funder lineage graphs per serial-scam family
updates.impact: funder_graph.py resolves the lineage (5 families) -> reports/funder_graph.json; fundergraph.py renders SVG lineage columns (token=cyan, deployer=red, funder=amber-if-reused) + summary tiles. The visual: instead of converging on ONE reused funder (which reputation could catch), every launch fans out to a fresh deployer AND funder. Wired into all page navs; served live at /fundergraph.
